description: Source code for KafkaWriter object in Spark SQL Kafka connector, responsible for writing data to Kafka from batch or streaming queries, including validation and expression handling.

classes.name: KafkaWriter
classes.description: Object responsible for writing data to Kafka, including validation and expression generation.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates the schema and topic options for writing to Kafka.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Performs the write operation to Kafka using the provided QueryExecution and Kafka parameters.

methods.name: topicExpression
methods.description: Generates an expression for the Kafka topic, either from provided option or schema attribute.

methods.name: keyExpression
methods.description: Generates an expression for the Kafka message key.

methods.name: valueExpression
methods.description: Generates an expression for the Kafka message value.

methods.name: headersExpression
methods.description: Generates an expression for Kafka message headers.

methods.name: partitionExpression
methods.description: Generates an expression for Kafka partition.

methods.name: expression
methods.description: Helper method to find or create an expression for a given attribute name and desired types.
